messages:
sophie: Kicking off regional rollout coordination for v2.3.1 — target sequence US -> EU -> APAC. Change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Plan: US canary 10% for 30m, then roll/ramp if green. Need infra capacity signoff + oncall watch. @matt @jordan @leanne

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v2.3.1 -> US at 2026-11-12T23:00:00Z (deploy id dpl_8f3). See dashboard: https://go/deploys/dpl_8f3 :robot_face:

matt: Infra quick check: US region currently has 18 warm p50 slots, 6 reserved. Warm pool GPUs: 4 (can be increased). No backlog in the job queue. With a 10% canary we expect ~40% headroom on avg token throughput due to autoscale buffers. Recommendation: proceed with 8-10% canary.

infra-bot: Capacity smoke results: token path stable, kv-cache hit-rate 82%, avg batch size 6. No OOMs in the last 1h. Link: https://go/infra/smoke/dpl_8f3

jordan: Oncall: I'll own SLO monitoring during canary. Key alerts to watch: request_success < 99.5% or 5xx spike > 0.5% sustained for 5m, p95 latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows => immediate rollback. I'll create a temporary dashboard slice for canary traffic. Pager assigned: @jordan.

leanne: Release notes: v2.3.1 adds structured-tool-calling + infer runtime perf tweaks. Feature gated behind ff_structured_calling (default off). For canary we'll enable ff_structured_calling for 10% traffic only. Docs PR: https://go/docs/v2.3.1 (will update with canary caveats).

sophie: Rollback/pinning plan: if rollback required, we pin route 'inference-main' back to v2.3.0 and enable auto_fallback. Config snippet for ops:
```
route: inference-main
pin_version: 'v2.3.0'
auto_fallback: true
thresholds: {errors_pct: 0.5, p95_ms: 600}
```
Keep the pin CLI handy: `rdw routes pin inference-main v2.3.0 --reason "rollback v2.3.1"`

matt: Pre-roll actions: increase warm pool to 6 GPUs for US, run cache warmup for the new tokens/kv shape. Commands: `infra/warmup.sh --region us --gpus 6 --model redwood-v2` and `infra/cachefill --prefix /prompts/v2`. Do these 20m before deploy to avoid cold-latency spikes.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary scheduled in 35 minutes. Next automated check at T-15m: capacity & traffic slice verification.

jordan: I'll set the alert thresholds and add a 5m suppression for harmless spike flaps. Also will enable synthetic canary p95 checks using the canary token set. Link to the dashboard: https://go/monitoring/canary_v231

leanne: I'll add a short note to the release notes about the canary scope and the rollback triggers so CS/Support have the exact wording. cc @support-team

infra-bot: Warm pool increase applied in us-west-2: 4 -> 6 GPUs. Cache warmup job started (job id cw_993). ETA ~12m. No errors reported.

sophie: Thanks team. Runbook reminders: follow the standard rollout runbook if rollback: https://go/runbooks/rollout-ops and notify #incidents if rolling back across regions. If all green after 30m, we'll ramp EU next with the same canary slice. APAC will be last and use a 5% canary first (timezone sensitivity). :pray: 

matt: One last note — pin window: keep v2.3.0 available as fallback for 2h after full rollout, then we'll deprecate after 48h when metrics stable.

deploy-bot: dpl_8f3: preflight checks passed. ETA to deploy: 18 minutes.

sophie: Oncall + infra, speak up if anything odd. I'll update this thread with go/no-go at T-5m.

jordan: Acknowledged. Will be on watch.

leanne: Acknowledged, prepping support blurb.

sophie: Go/no-go at T-5m: GO unless SLO alerts or unexpected queue growth. Posting final shortly.
